description: A 1HP stereo mixer with three channels, each with a VCA, a pan control and a mute, and a stereo chain input for joining several of them

params.text: Sets the level of that channel
Places that channel between the left and right outputs
Sets the level of both outputs

inputs.text: A voltage controlling the level of that channel
The left side of a stereo signal from another mixer, added to the left output
The right side of a stereo signal from another mixer, added to the right output

outputs.text: The left side of the mix
The right side of the mix

notes: the panel is one unit wide and prints only CH 1, CH 2, CH 3, CHAIN and OUT
the right-click menu carries a legend headed M1 LEGENDA that names every control in order, from IN SIGNAL down to OUT RIGHT
menu: Exponential mode — makes the level controls follow an exponential curve rather than a straight line
